reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Promote image CLI commands to stable by @dgunzy in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5421", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The image CLI commands are reclassified as stable in the flux CLI; the release note describes no functional change, so there is no operational consequence for an operator beyond the reclassification.

proposed.statement: The flux 2.7.0 release notes state that the image CLI commands are promoted to stable; the note describes no functional change, so an operator sees no operational consequence.
